sources.derivation: Eq. (5.38): Z=2^|Lambda| (cosh K)^|E| sum over even edge sets of (tanh K)^|E|. With d=3 there are 3 edges per site and the smallest even sets are the 3 elementary plaquettes per site (4 edges each); clusters of two or more polymers start at order tanh^8. So p=log 2+3 log cosh K+3 tanh^4 K+O(K^6). 3 log cosh K=3K^2/2-K^4/4+O(K^6) and 3 tanh^4 K=3K^4+O(K^6), giving 11K^4/4. Then e=-p' and c=K^2 p'' term by term, valid inside the analyticity disk of Theorem 5.13.

sources.derivation: Eq. (5.41): a contour of |gamma| plaquettes has weight exp(-2K|gamma|), and the prefactor exp(K|E|) gives 3K per site. One flipped spin is a closed contour of 6 plaquettes (exp(-12K), one per site); an adjacent flipped pair has 10 (exp(-20K), three per site). So p=3K+exp(-12K)+O(exp(-20K)); e=-p' and c=K^2 p'' follow term by term.

sources.derivation: Their reduced temperature t'=beta_c/beta-1 (eq. 25) is the task's t=Kc/K-1. With p_s=B|t|^(2-alpha), d/dK=(dt/dK) d/dt and K^2 (dt/dK)^2=Kc^2/K^2 tends to 1 at Kc, so c=K^2 p'' has leading singular term B(2-alpha)(1-alpha)|t|^(-alpha); e has exponent 1-alpha. Their f and E are per link (factor 3 against the task's per-site p and e); only exponents and the structure are used, not their fitted values.
